name: s3:GetObject on the bare glob '?*' (any non-empty resource) must warn
note: S1-dataexfil-arn iteration 5 regression, NON-arn glob class. '?*' ( '?' = exactly one char, '*' = any run ) matches every resource string of length >=1 - i.e. every resource in every account/service - yet it carries no 'arn:' prefix, so the old arn:-prefix gate read it as NOT broad and the bulk read returned findings=[] exit 0 CLEAN (DATA-EXFIL fail-open, T8). Now decided semantically against the probe battery (matches probes across >=2 distinct accounts), so DATA-EXFIL fires. GetObject is a read verb, so WILDCARD-RESOURCE must NOT fire.
